name: Sandy Adams
summary: Sandra Adams (born December 14, 1956) is an American politician and Air Force veteran who served as the U.S. representative for Florida's 24th congressional district from 2011 to 2013. A member of the Republican Party, she previously served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2002 to 2010. In 2012, she was defeated in her bid for re-election after being redistricted to the 7th district.
